ArtifactRef.description: A lightweight pointer carried in results, events and RPC messages.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

BBox.description: Axis-aligned box; ``x0,y0`` is the top-left corner, ``x1,y1`` the bottom-right.
BBox.title: BBox

CalculationEvidence.description: A deterministic computation: the expression and the evidence ids of its inputs.
CalculationEvidence.title: CalculationEvidence

CoordinateSystem.description: Where a box/point lives. Evidence always records this so it can be mapped back.
CoordinateSystem.title: CoordinateSystem

DpiTransform.description: PDF points → pixels at a given DPI (72 points per inch).
DpiTransform.title: DpiTransform

ExifOrientTransform.description: The EXIF orientation applied to make a ``width`` x ``height`` image upright.
ExifOrientTransform.title: ExifOrientTransform

FieldMeta.description: Per-field sidecar: evidence, issues and extraction status (ADR-0005).
FieldMeta.title: FieldMeta

LineageEvidence.description: Points at a parent artifact and the transformation that produced the current one.
LineageEvidence.title: LineageEvidence

ProducerRef.description: What produced an artifact, evidence item or result: a tool, a model or the runtime.
ProducerRef.title: ProducerRef

RepairKind.description: What the runtime may try for a repairable issue (blueprint §16).
RepairKind.title: RepairKind

RunStatus.description: Run lifecycle. See :mod:`hawser.runtime.state` for the allowed transitions.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

TextSpanEvidence.description: A character range in a text/JSON input or in a derived text artifact.
TextSpanEvidence.title: TextSpanEvidence

TimeOffsetTransform.description: Output time t maps to input time ``t + offset_ms`` (for clips and chunks).
